name: A Donation of Wool
summary: The Windshapers are accepting wool cloth donations. Sixty pieces earn their full recognition for your generosity.

sections.title: A Gift of Wool
sections.body: The Windshapers accept donations of wool cloth. Their representative can take sixty pieces from you when you are ready to give them.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are accepting donations of wool cloth.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth earns full recognition from the Windshapers.

faq.q: What do I get for donating the wool?
faq.answer: Donating sixty pieces of wool cloth earns full recognition from the Windshapers for your generosity.

faq.q: Can their representative take the wool now?
faq.answer: The representative can take the sixty pieces if you have them with you and are ready to donate.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Wool
